# 2. Data Introduction
<!-- 
* You must summarize what the data corresponds to in your own words.  It should also be very clear which data area the data belongs to.
* Provide a brief data dictionary that describes what the variables are.
* You will provide a link to where you originally obtained the data.  This should be in the main body, but can provided again in citations.
* You must also provide a link to the data itself in the main body (and again in the citations).  We must be able to click on the link that you provide, we can immediately get the data without any additional effort. You may want to store the data in Google drive for this purpose.
    * Do not upload any .csv files to canvas!

Data used in this exploratory data analysis is sports data from from Baseball Savant, a third-party website run by the MLB, where all of their Statcast data is stored. [Here](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search) is a link to the Baseball Savant website, where you can filter through all wanted variables. The data used in this analysis is pitch-by-pitch data from the 2025 regular MLB season with 25,000 observations. [Here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_zxPBT3iTcbFs3PdsiJ9JdB-IF8XxnXb9x7-mVuE-XU/edit?usp=sharing) is the link to the final data obtained from Baseball Savant. Below is a brief data dictionary describing the variables within the dataset. 

| Variable | Description |
| -------- | -------- |
|game_date|Date of Game.|
|release_speed|Pitch velocity in MPH.|
|release_pos_x|Horizontal Release Position of the ball measured in feet from the catcher's perspective.|
|release_pos_z|Vertical Release Position of the ball measured in feet from the catcher's perspective|
|player_name|Pitcher's name.|
|batter|MLB player ID tied to the play of the event.|
|pitcher|MLB player ID tied to the play of the event.|
|events|Event of the resulting Plate Appearance.|
|description|Description of the resulting pitch.|
|zone| Zone location (1 through 12) of the ball when it crosses the plate from the catchers perspective.|
|des|Plate appearance description from game day.|
|stand|Side of the plate batter is standing.|
|p_throws|Hand pitcher throws with.|
|home_team|Abbreviation of home team.|
|away_team|Abbreviation of away team.|
|type|Short hand of pitch result. B = ball, S = Strike, X = in play.|
|hit_location|Position of first fielder to touch the ball.|
|bb_type|Batted ball type.|
|balls|Pre-pitch number of balls in count.|
|strikes|Pre-pitch number of strikes in count.|
|pfx_x|Horizontal movement in feet from the catcher's perspective.|
|pfx_z|Vertical movement in feet from the catcher's perspective.|
|plate_x|Horizontal position of the ball when it crosses home plate from the catcher's perspective.|
|plate_z|Vertical position of the ball when it crosses home plate from the catcher's perspective.|
|on_3b|Pre-pitch MLB player ID of Runner on 3B.|
|on_2b|Pre-pitch MLB player ID of Runner on 2B.|
|on_1b|Pre-pitch MLB player ID of Runner on 1B.|
|outs_when_up|Pre-pitch number of outs.|
|inning|Pre-pitch inning number.|
|inning_topbot|Pre-pitch top or bottom of inning.|
|hc_x|Hit coordinate X of batted ball.|
|hc_y|Hit coordinate Y of batted ball.|
|vx0|Velocity of pitch, in feet per second, in the x-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|vy0|Velocity of pitch, in feet per second, in the y-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|vz0|Velocity of pitch, in feet per second, in the z-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|ax|Acceleration of pitch, in feet per second, in the x-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|ay|Acceleration of pitch, in feet per second, in the y-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|az|Acceleration of pitch, in feet per second, in the z-dimension, determined at y=50 feet.|
|sz_top|Top of the batter's strike zone set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate.|
|sz_bot|Bottom of the batter's strike zone set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate.|
|hit_distance_sc|Projected hit distance of the batted ball.|
|launch_speed|Exit velocity of the batted ball as tracked by Statcast.|
|launch_angle|Launch angle of the batted ball as tracked by Statcast.|
|effective_speed|Derived speed based on the extension of the pitcher's release.|
|release_spin_rate|Spin rate of pitch tracked by Statcast|
|release_extension|Release extension of pitch in feet as tracked by Statcast|
|game_pk|Unique ID for Game.|
|fielder_2|MLB Player ID for catcher.|
|fielder_3|MLB Player ID for 1B.|
|fielder_4|MLB Player ID for 2B.|
|fielder_5|MLB Player ID for 3B.|
|fielder_6|MLB Player ID for SS.|
|fielder_7|MLB Player ID for LF.|
|fielder_8|MLB Player ID for CF.|
|fielder_9|MLB Player ID for RF.|
|release_pos_y|Release position of pitch measured in feet from the catcher's perspective.|
|estimated_ba_using_speedangle|Estimated Batting Avg based on launch angle and exit velocity.|
|estimated_woba_using_speedangle|Estimated wOBA based on launch angle and exit velocity.|
|woba_value|wOBA value based on result of play.|
|woba_denom|wOBA denominator based on result of play.|
|babip_value|BABIP value based on result of play.|
|iso_value|ISO value based on result of play.|
|launch_speed_angle|Launch speed/angle zone based on launch angle and exit velocity.|
|at_bat_number|Plate appearance number of the game.|
|pitch_number|Total pitch number of the plate appearance.|
|pitch_name|The name of the pitch derived from the Statcast Data.|
|home_score|Pre-pitch home score.|
|away_score|Pre-pitch away score.|
|bat_score|Pre-pitch bat team score.|
|fld_score|Pre-pitch field team score.|
|post_away_score|Post-pitch away score.|
|post_home_score|Post-pitch home score.|
|post_bat_score|Post-pitch bat team score.|
|post_fld_score||
|if_fielding_alignment|Infield fielding alignment at the time of the pitch.|
|of_fielding_alignment|Outfield fielding alignment at the time of the pitch.|
|spin_axis|The Spin Axis in the 2D X-Z plane in degrees from 0 to 360.|
|delta_home_win_exp|The change in Win Expectancy before the Plate Appearance and after.|
|delta_run_exp|The change in Run Expectancy before the Plate Appearance and after|
|bat_speed||
|swing_length||
|miss_distance||
|estimated_slg_using_speedangle||
|delta_pitcher_run_exp||
|hyper_speed|Adjusted Exit Velocity. Sets every batted ball hit below 88mph as 88mph|
|home_score_diff|Home score minus Away score.|
|bat_score_diff|Batting team score less Pitching team score.|
|home_win_exp|Home team win expectancy.|
|bat_win_exp|Bat team win expectancy.|
|age_pit_legacy|Pitcher age on 6/30.|
|age_bat_legacy|Batter age on 6/30.|
|age_pit|Pitcher age on 12/31.|
|age_bat|Batter age on 12/31.|
|n_thruorder_pitcher|Pitcher times through order.|
|n_priorpa_thisgame_player_at_bat|Number of prior Plate Appearances in this game for this batter.|
|pitcher_days_since_prev_game|Number of days sinces pitcher's last game.|
|batter_days_since_prev_game|Number of days since batter's last game.|
|pitcher_days_until_next_game|Number of days until pitcher's next game.|
|api_break_z_with_gravity|Vertical break with gravity included.|
|api_break_x_arm|Break, in inches, of a pitch toward the batter's side of the plate.|
|api_break_x_batter_in|Break, in inches, of a pitch toward the batter's side of plate.|
|arm_angle|The angle between a line parallel to the ground and a l line extending from the location of the pitcher's throwing shoulder and the location of the ball at the time of the pitch.|
|attack_angle|Measures the vertical angle of the direction in which the sweet spot of the bat is traveling as it impacts the ball, as compared to the ground.|
|attack_direction|measures the horizontal angle of the direction in which the sweet spot of the bat is traveling as it impacts the ball, as compared to a line from home plate to straightaway center field.|
|swing_path_tilt|The vertical angular orientation of the "plane" of the swing, as compared to the ground, defined by the path of the bat in the 40 ms prior to contact.|
|intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches|Distance, in inches, between the intercept point of the bat/ball and the batter's center of mass, in the X (horizontal) direction.|
|intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches|Distance, in inches, between the intercept point of the bat/ball and the batter's center of mass, in the Y (mound-to-plate) direction.|

## Plot 1: 

![Plot 1](/Users/avanadolski/Desktop/Strike%20Percentage%20by%20Pitch%20Type.png){width="40%"}

The plot represents the strike percentage of all the specific pitch types. Throwing strikes is your goal as the pitcher, so knowing what gives you the best chances is important. Something worth noting are that the top three variables that have the highest strike percentage are all considered fastballs.



## Plot 2: 

![Plot 2](/Users/avanadolski/Desktop/Accuracy%20Strike%20Zone.png){width="40%"}

Plot 2 represents the accuracy of pitches within the strike zone. The red box is the average strike zone of any given batter. In connection with the above plot, it is important to throw within the strike zone because you want to through strikes. 



## Plot 3:

![Plot 3](/Users/avanadolski/Desktop/Common%20Pitch%20by%20Count.png){width="40%"}

Plot 3 shows the proportion of pitches thrown given a specifc ball-strike count. Overwhelmingly, fastballs are most popular pitch over all counts. It is most dominant on a 3-0 count, when a pitcher is one throw away from walking a batter to first base. In connection from plot 1, throwing a fastball seems probable from a pitcher because it has the highest chance of resulting in a strike. 



## Plot 4:

![Plot 4](/Users/avanadolski/Desktop/Pitch%20Outcome%20by%20Velo.png){width="40%"}

Plot 4 shows the distribution of pitching velocity within the possible outcomes of a pitch. Something that sticks out is that the mean velocity when the pitch results in a swinging strike is the lowest out of all the other outcomes. Most likely the cause is that batters swing on a disguised fastball such as a change up.

## Table 1:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# get first pitches (where count is 0-0)
first_pitch_data <- baseballData[baseballData$balls == 0 & baseballData$strikes == 0 &
                                   !is.na(baseballData$pitch_name) & baseballData$pitch_name != "", ]

# total number of first pitches
n_total_first_pitches <- nrow(first_pitch_data)

# counting number of first pitches to a specific pitch
n_pitches <- tapply(first_pitch_data$type, first_pitch_data$pitch_name, length)

# create table
first_pitch <- data.frame(
  pitch_name = names(n_pitches),
  n_pitches = as.numeric(n_pitches),
  pct_of_first_pitches = round((as.numeric(n_pitches) / n_total_first_pitches * 100), 2)
)

# order table in decreasing number of pitches
first_pitch <- first_pitch[order(-first_pitch$n_pitches), ]

# display table
first_pitch
```
Table 1 represents, given the first pitch of an at-bat, what pitch type is most common. As shown in the table above, the classic four-seam fastball is overwhelmingly the favored pitch type. 

## Table 2:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# counting horizontal break values by pitch name
pitch_name = tapply(baseballData$pfx_x, baseballData$pitch_name, length)

# calculating the mean of horizontal/vertical break and spin rate  by pitch name
avg_horizontal_break <- tapply(baseballData$pfx_x, baseballData$pitch_name, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_vertical_break <- tapply(baseballData$pfx_z, baseballData$pitch_name, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_spin_rate <- tapply(baseballData$release_spin_rate, baseballData$pitch_name, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# create the data frame, rounding when needed
pitch_movement <- data.frame(
  pitch_name = names(pitch_name),
  avg_spin_rate = round((as.numeric(avg_spin_rate)), 2),
  avg_horizontal_break = round((as.numeric(abs(avg_horizontal_break))), 4),
  avg_vertical_break = round((as.numeric(avg_vertical_break)), 4)
  )

# order by decreasing spin rate
pitch_movement <- pitch_movement[order(-pitch_movement$avg_spin_rate), ]

# display table
pitch_movement
```

**Definitions:**
MLB: Major League Baseball
Statcast: An advanced tracking system used by the MLB to collect and analyze precise data on every play, player movement, pitch, and hit in real time.

**Code:**
Needed imports: tidyverse, ggplot2

Plot 1: 
```{r, results='hide', fig.show='hide'}
# remove null values
baseballData_clean <- baseballData[!is.na(baseballData$pitch_name) & baseballData$pitch_name != "", ]

# aggregate pitch name into strike percentage categories
pitch_summary <- aggregate(
  type ~ pitch_name,
  data = baseballData_clean,
  # calculating strike percentage
  FUN = function(x) c(n = length(x), strike_pct = mean(x %in% c("S", "X")) * 100))

# put all values into a new data frame
pitch_summary <- data.frame(
  pitch_name = pitch_summary$pitch_name,
  n_pitches = pitch_summary$type[, "n"],
  strike_pct = pitch_summary$type[, "strike_pct"]
)

# remove pitches that are rare
pitch_summary <- pitch_summary[pitch_summary$n_pitches >= 10, ]

# create plot
ggplot(pitch_summary, aes(x = reorder(pitch_name, strike_pct), y = strike_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(strike_pct, 1)), hjust = -0.1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Strike Percentage by Pitch Type",
    x = "Pitch Type",
    y = "Strike %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Plot 2:
```{r, results='hide', fig.show='hide'}
# calculate average zone boundaries across all pitches
zone_top <- mean(baseballData$sz_top, na.rm = TRUE)
zone_bot <- mean(baseballData$sz_bot, na.rm = TRUE)

# create plot
ggplot(baseballData, aes(x = plate_x, y = plate_z)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "black") +
  # add strike zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.85, xmax = 0.85, ymin = zone_bot, ymax = zone_top,
           fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy of Pitches With in the Strike Zone",
    x = "Horizontal Location",
    y = "Vertical Location"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Plot 3:
```{r, results='hide', fig.show='hide'}
# define more general pitch type groupings
fastballs <- c("4-Seam Fastball", "Sinker", "Cutter", "Fastball")
breaking  <- c("Slider", "Curveball", "Sweeper", "Slurve", "Knuckle Curve", "Screwball", "Slow Curve")
offspeed  <- c("Changeup", "Splitter", "Forkball", "Eephus", "Knuckleball", "Slurve")

# group pitch types based on the above groupings
pitch_group <- ifelse(
  baseballData$pitch_name %in% fastballs, "Fastball",
  ifelse(baseballData$pitch_name %in% breaking, "Breaking Ball",
  ifelse(baseballData$pitch_name %in% offspeed, "Offspeed", "Other"))
)

# combine balls and strikes into one value
count <- paste(baseballData$balls, baseballData$strikes, sep = "-")
# factor new count variable
count_order <- c("0-0","0-1","0-2","1-0","1-1","1-2","2-0","2-1","2-2","3-0","3-1","3-2")
count <- factor(count, levels = count_order)

# create plot
ggplot(baseballData, aes(x = count, fill = pitch_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Fastball" = 'darkblue',
    "Breaking Ball" = "blue",
    "Offspeed" = "lightblue",
    "Other" = "grey"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Which Pitch is Most Common Given a Specific Count",
    x = "Count (Balls-Strikes)",
    y = "Proportion of Pitches",
    fill = "Pitch Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Plot 4:
```{r, results='hide', fig.show='hide'}
# remove null values
baseballData_clean <- baseballData[!is.na(baseballData$release_speed) & !is.na(baseballData$description), ]

# group outcomes into more general categories
outcome <- ifelse(
  baseballData_clean$description %in% c("ball", "blocked_ball"), "Ball",
  ifelse(baseballData_clean$description %in% c("called_strike"), "Strike",
  ifelse(baseballData_clean$description %in% c("swinging_strike", "swinging_strike_blocked"), "Swinging Strike",
  ifelse(baseballData_clean$description == "foul", "Foul",
  ifelse(baseballData_clean$description == "hit_into_play", "In Play", "Other")))))

# create plot
ggplot(baseballData_clean, aes(x = outcome, y = release_speed, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Pitch Outcome Given Distribution of Pitch Velocity",
    x = "Pitch Outcome",
    y = "Pitching Velocity (mph)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
